stories.summary: Meta’s new AI agent Muse recorded more downloads and daily active users in the United States and Canada than ChatGPT did over the equivalent period after its mobile debut. The comparison is based on estimates from the app-intelligence firm Appfigures.

stories.summary: Silent Hill: Townfall brings tragedy and an apocalyptic fog to a Scottish fishing community, with outsider Simon tasked with providing some form of closure. The Guardian’s review says the PlayStation 5 and PC game evokes 1990s Britain through details including boxy cars and period-style phone boxes.

stories.summary: Hamas released four female Israeli soldiers in the second hostage release since a multiphase Gaza ceasefire agreement took effect. The release raised hopes that the deal could lead to a lasting end to the war.

stories.title: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
stories.summary: The world’s three largest container shipping operators remain wary of returning to Red Sea routes despite a Houthi pledge to stop targeting vessels. They say instability in Gaza and wider regional tensions continue to pose a danger.

links.headline: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
